description: This is a PHP class file defining the 'FilterGroup' model in the OpenCart admin module for catalog filters. It includes methods for CRUD operations related to filter groups, such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving filter group data and descriptions.

classes.name: FilterGroup
classes.description: Model class for managing filter groups in the catalog, including CRUD operations and related data handling.

methods.name: addFilterGroup
methods.description: Creates a new filter group and its descriptions, then returns its ID.

methods.name: editFilterGroup
methods.description: Updates an existing filter group and its descriptions based on the provided ID.

methods.name: deleteFilterGroup
methods.description: Deletes a filter group and its descriptions based on ID.

methods.name: getFilterGroup
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific filter group by ID.

methods.name: getFilterGroups
methods.description: Fetches all filter groups, optionally sorted and paginated.

methods.name: getTotalFilterGroups
methods.description: Returns the total number of filter groups in the database.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a filter group in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specific filter group.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all filter group descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a given filter group.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches filter group descriptions filtered by language ID.
